notes:
LTTH Version 1.4.1 Release Notes

LTTH remains at 1.4.1 while the official plugin store publishes Stream Monsters 1.10.0 as an independent Open Beta plugin release.

- NEW: The Living Egg Shelf animates eight full-size eggs plus prioritized overflow above the lower 26 percent reserved for TikTok chat
- NEW: Gift eggs are owned immediately; only optional recurring free-egg offers use !adopt and public gold-ring callouts
- NEW: Jackpot Clash adds full-monster choreography, combo feedback, element lighting, readable skill cards, and HP, shield, and Special HUDs
- IMPROVED: Sealed A/B/C action windows last eight seconds and reveal both choices together
- IMPROVED: Passive Special charge pauses during cinematics, reconnect recovery, and completed battles
- IMPROVED: GCCE command consumption, chat TTS, owner identity, avatar proxying, and hatch feedback share explicit safe contracts
- COMPATIBILITY: The stable streamalchemy plugin ID, player data, legacy replays, and every published Stream Monsters archive through 1.9.0 remain preserved
- RELEASE: streamalchemy-1.10.0.zip is built reproducibly from its recorded Git source and verified by SHA-256
